title: delete() leaks its SQLite connection (missing closing())
evidence: app.py:79 `with self._connect() as connection:` — the sqlite3 connection context manager commits/rolls back but does NOT close; every other BookStore method (app.py:23,44,53,63,68) wraps the connect in contextlib.closing(). delete() therefore leaves the connection open until GC.
suggestion: Wrap as `with closing(self._connect()) as connection, connection:` to match the other methods.
